user.title: Connect to Webtop
user.description: Sign in with the same username and password you use at webtop.smartschool.co.il. A parent login sees every linked child.

data_description.data: Leave empty. The integration computes the 'Data' value of the login request from your username. Fill this in only to force a value captured from the browser.
data_description.user_agent: The User-Agent the integration sends to the portal. Leave empty and it says what it is: the name of this integration, its version and its address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Webtop server. Check the connection and try again.
error.blocked: The portal's firewall refused the connection (HTTP 403) before the portal saw the request. This is not a password problem: the portal is blocking this client or this network.
error.invalid_auth: Webtop rejected the login. Check the username and password by signing in at webtop.smartschool.co.il.
error.captcha_required: Webtop is asking for a captcha before it accepts a password login from this network. Sign in once in a browser, wait a while, then try again.
error.too_many_attempts: Webtop locked this account after too many failed attempts. Wait, or reset the password on the portal.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Webtop account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials belong to a different Webtop account.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between polls of the Webtop portal.
data_description.lesson_times: A default for students whose school publishes no lesson times. List them in lesson order, for example: 08:00-08:45, 08:45-09:30, 09:50-10:35. Prefix a lesson number to skip ahead: 0=07:15-08:00. With several students you are asked about each one next.
data_description.night_pause: Do not contact the portal between 23:00 and 06:00. The Refresh button still works.
data_description.read_unread_messages: Off: the text of a message is fetched only after you have read it on the portal. On: unread messages are fetched too, so their text reaches Home Assistant right away. Fetching a message marks it as read on the portal, exactly as opening it does, so the portal's unread badge clears and the school may see it as read.
data_description.user_agent: The User-Agent the integration sends to the portal. Leave empty and it says what it is: the name of this integration, its version and its address.

student.title: Lesson times for {student}
student.description: The portal publishes {portal_hours} lesson times for {student}. Type this student's own lesson times to use them instead, or leave empty to use the portal's, falling back to the account default.

error.invalid_lesson_times: Could not read the lesson times. Use the form 08:00-08:45, 08:45-09:30, with each lesson ending after it starts.
